source_text: Sors Simeon in medio Iudae — pars in laude. Zelus (Simeon) castigatus habitat in confessione.
pass_a_gloss: Lot of-Simeon in midst of-Judah — part in praise. Zeal (Simeon) chastened dwells in confession.
pass_b_english: [[Simeon’s lot lies within Judah >> Bible:Joshua 19:1-9]] — a share inside praise. Chastened zeal dwells in confession.
